hook: Turbulence is physics' hardest unsolved problem

beats.say: Turbulence is called the hardest remaining problem in classical physics, and we still do not exactly know how it works.
More than 200 people were seriously injured in turbulence on US airplanes between 2009 and 2023, according to FAA data.
Now terabytes of crowdsourced flight data and new machine learning may help pilots get ten to fifteen minutes of warning before the choppiness hits.
